title: Thread-Safe Spot Allocator with Timeout and a Stress Test
instructions: In `parking/allocator.py` implement `SpotAllocator` (the `Spot`, `SpotStatus`, `VehicleType`, exceptions, `Strategy` type and `first_fit` are given). One lock, created once in `__init__`, guards the whole spot collection: `allocate(vehicle_type, timeout=None)` finds and marks a spot as a single critical section, raises `ParkingFullError` when nothing fits and `AllocationTimeoutError` when the lock cannot be acquired within `timeout` seconds, and always releases the lock in a `finally`. `release(spot)` frees a spot under the same lock.

evidence.label: 16 threads making random allocations never receive the same spot twice
Releasing a spot makes it allocatable again
allocate marks the spot OCCUPIED, returns only a spot supporting the type and raises ParkingFullError otherwise
A spot supporting car and truck is claimed by exactly one of many competing car and truck threads
A caller blocked on the lock raises AllocationTimeoutError after the timeout
After ParkingFullError the lock is released and later calls still work
If the strategy raises, the lock is still released
The injected strategy decides which spot is chosen
